title: Solar frame (solar.json in a .cwp)
description: The facts about the world's sun that a scenario's start time is checked against without a server: the origin the engine computes the sun from, and the time zone the engine sets from its longitude.

origin_latitude.description: WGS84 latitude, degrees, of the world's origin.

origin_longitude.description: WGS84 longitude, degrees, of the world's origin.

engine_time_zone_hours.description: The zone the engine sets, hours east of UTC: origin_longitude / 15. Local mean solar time, not the site's civil zone.

engine_time_zone.description: The same zone as a signed offset, hours:minutes:seconds.

engine_daylight_saving.description: Whether the engine applies daylight saving. It does not.

engine_solar_time_at_configure_hours.description: The solar time, hours, the engine sets when the world's georeference is configured.
